analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current Price($530.15) vs SMA5($532.81)/SMA20($524.99)/SMA50($507.14): Above SMA20, below SMA5 indicating short-term volatility range.
· Maintaining strong mid-to-long-term trend by staying well above SMA100($458.02)/SMA200($434.91).

[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (0.8998 → -1.1103): Worsening confirmed, potential signal for bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $524.99): Consolidating around the middle band, band width narrowed to 9.12%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($517.55): Support zone based on SMA20.
· Swing Resistance ($531.03): Facing resistance, trading below 5-day high($543.82).
· 5-day High($543.82)/Low($524.43), 20-day High($551.15)/Low($491.22): 5-day high < 20-day high * 0.995 → Lower High pattern confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.10): Subdued volume compared to 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation): Maintaining wait-and-see stance due to failure to break short-term resistance and weakening momentum.
